specs.name: 猫
specs.detail: The original orange tabby cat, cream muzzle/chest/toe tips, original tiger stripes, pink nose and inner ears, glossy dark eyes. Natural feline sitting on its haunches: hindquarters lowered to the ground, two front legs placed vertically together beneath the chest, hind paws tucked, and the one cream-tipped striped tail quietly curling beside the body on the ground. Keep the existing head design exactly; do not turn it into a generic chibi cat.
specs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single still resting-pose pixel-art sprite for the existing PetCast pet.
Input image 1 is the EXACT original PetCast animal identity reference. Preserve this specific animal's face, eye shape, original colors, markings, ear anatomy, dark warm pixel outline, body proportions and friendly detailed chunky pixel-art style. Change only the stance into a comfortable natural stationary seated/resting pose.
Produce ONE full-body animal, not a sprite sheet, not multiple views. Transparent RGBA background, square canvas ideally 1024x1024. Center the complete animal with a generous 15 percent transparent margin around all ears, tail and paws. Keep the same right-facing three-quarter view as the reference. Crisp visible pixel clusters at a consistent scale, with no smooth cartoon/vector rendering, no realism, no 3D and no extra texture.
The purpose is an extremely quiet breathing-only idle animation, so the base pose must be steady: all paws resting, tail resting, ears relaxed but motionless, eyes calmly OPEN, mouth neutral and unchanged. No blinking, panting, tongue, bouncing, walking, waving or energetic expression. No environment, no cushion, no chair, no props, no ground, no cast shadows, no text, labels, grid or watermark. Preserve correct non-human animal anatomy.
Subject-specific invariants and resting stance:
The original orange tabby cat, cream muzzle/chest/toe tips, original tiger stripes, pink nose and inner ears, glossy dark eyes. Natural feline sitting on its haunches: hindquarters lowered to the ground, two front legs placed vertically together beneath the chest, hind paws tucked, and the one cream-tipped striped tail quietly curling beside the body on the ground. Keep the existing head design exactly; do not turn it into a generic chibi cat.

specs.name: 狗
specs.detail: The original honey-golden puppy with long caramel floppy ears, cream muzzle/chest/toes, black rounded nose and dark glossy eyes. A calm anatomically correct puppy sit, hindquarters resting on the ground and both front paws placed steadily under the chest. Its single tail rests beside the haunches, mouth closed; do not add panting or change the breed.

specs.name: 鸡
specs.detail: The original cream-white chicken with deep red comb and wattle, golden-yellow beak and feet, tiny dark eye and short feather tail. A relaxed crouched resting hen with belly lowered, wings folded tightly, and two golden feet tucked under its body with their tips naturally visible. Not an egg-shaped baby chick and not a human sitting; preserve the original comb, beak and feather design.

specs.name: 兔子
specs.detail: The original cream-white rabbit with asymmetrically posed very long ears, pale pink inner ears, tiny pink nose, glossy dark eye and fluffy round tail. Quietly sitting low on its haunches, hind paws tucked and front paws resting together beneath the chest, head upright and original ear pose preserved. No hopping, no crouch ready to spring, no closed sleeping eyes and no new markings.
